item.title: Graffiti requiring removal – Sondes Street, SE17, 6th September
item.description:
There is graffiti on Sondes Street, SE17, which needs to be removed or painted over. This is adding to the general deterioration of the area, particularly alongside the repeated fly-tipping problems that residents are already having to report. These issues are becoming increasingly frustrating and give the impression that the street is not being adequately maintained. Please could Southwark Council arrange for the graffiti to be removed as soon as possible and ensure that Sunday Street is being properly monitored and maintained going forward.

item.title: Repeated fly-tipping with food waste, flies in Sondes Street – SE17, 6th September
item.description:
I am reporting yet another incident of fly-tipping in the SE17 area. There is currently a bag containing food waste which is attracting flies and maggots, along with clothing and other rubbish scattered around the area. This is now a public health and environmental concern and needs to be cleared as soon as possible in sondes street SE17 Unfortunately, this is not an isolated incident. Fly-tipping has become a regular occurrence around Phelps Street and Sondes Street, with particular locations repeatedly being used as dumping spots. This has been going on for approximately two years and residents should not have to continually report the same problem. I believe much of this dumping may be taking place late at night. I have seen people in the area pushing trolleys containing various items, although I cannot say for certain who is responsible. I would appreciate Southwark Council not only arranging for the current waste to be removed, but also looking at preventative measures in these streets. There appears to be little or no signage warning against fly-tipping, despite the fact that these are known recurring locations. I am increasingly frustrated that this has been allowed to continue for so long, and I intend to raise the ongoing problem with the South London Press if more effective action is not taken. Please could this waste be removed urgently due to the flies and maggots, and could the repeated fly-tipping problem around Phelps Street and Sunday Street be properly investigated

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Sondes Street, Walworth, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
